mapper.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kb_document_chunk ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, state INT NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as failedCount FROM kb_document_chunk
